native_scope: Forge/Neo actual BlockBehaviour and Properties noCollission/empty-shape path; old official Block bytecode is supplementary constructor/light context, not a full old Forge installation.

signal_probe.scope: Actual core class, baseline renamed copy, original explicit onTickStart signal body with only super delegation omitted and captured bind_/scan expressions. All portals active. No world, deactivate/unload, native neighbor notifications or cross-dimension execution.

comment_corrections: The two dimensions GT6's own mini portals serve (see the subclasses of {@code MultiTileEntityMiniPortal}).
The two dimension pairs currently supported by this port.
GT6's portal properties: obsidian/end stone hardness, no collision, light while it is open.
Current portal properties: source hardness, with port-specific collision and lighting settings.

formal_findings_added.finding: Seventeen original optional dimension mini portals have no current target/registration implementation.
formal_findings_added.scope: Old loader registers all nineteen; seventeen carry hidden/recipe gates when their dependency mods are absent. Optional compatibility backlog, not seventeen failures in a vanilla-only installation.

formal_findings_added.finding: Mini portal magnifying-glass target/no-target diagnostic has no native tool consumer binding.
formal_findings_added.scope: Activation coordinate messages exist; they do not provide the original independent magnifier operation. Covered-face generic cover messages are a separate path.

formal_findings_added.finding: End portal activation narrows ore-dictionary gemEnderEye membership to exact Items.ENDER_EYE.
formal_findings_added.scope: Compatibility acceptance contract; no claim that a specific additional member is installed in the current test pack.

formal_findings_added.finding: Original full-block collision becomes no collision on both mini portals.
formal_findings_added.scope: Original MultiTileEntityBlock full fallback and inherited Root full box, with no portal/parent collision override, versus current noCollission/native empty shape. No claim based solely on a direct interface declaration. Rendered frame geometry is not movement collision.

formal_findings_added.finding: Explicit light opacity changes from 1 to 0.
formal_findings_added.scope: Original LIGHT_OPACITY_LEAVES constant versus current getLightBlock. World lighting/render appearance and the independent active emission setting 11 are not declared verified.

formal_findings_added.finding: Item tooltips omit original closest-active selection and chunk-loader requirement.
formal_findings_added.scope: Compare actual appendHoverText consumers and referenced language values, not the mere existence of unused language keys.

formal_findings_added.finding: Active Nether mini portal lacks original four-particle random-display callback.
formal_findings_added.scope: Native block has no animation callback/client ticker; animated portal texture exists and is not the missing world particle behavior.

original_dispatcher.text: @Override public final void randomDisplayTick(World aWorld, int aX, int aY, int aZ, Random aRandom) {TileEntity aTileEntity = aWorld.getTileEntity(aX, aY, aZ); if (aTileEntity instanceof IMTE_RandomDisplayTick) ((IMTE_RandomDisplayTick)aTileEntity).randomDisplayTick(aRandom); else super.randomDisplayTick(aWorld, aX, aY, aZ, aRandom);}

formal_findings_extended.scope: Original mini portal client late-activation portal sound has no corresponding current client transition callback.
Mini portal native comparator calls comparator(null) and merges all six outputs, while old getComparatorInputOverride takes a side. Internal portal/extender side-aware queries remain.

positive_scope: Two actual dimension pairs have factor/margin 8/128 and 128/512, nearest horizontal target and Y tie breaker; no chunk-force-load requested in target lookup.
Opposite neighbor addressing, shared item/fluid/GT-energy forwarding and both platform FE entry points exist. No live cross-dimensional transfer certification.
Both dimension models have the original thirteen active / twelve inactive box coordinates; no pixel/face-culling/render certification.
Pure core active-state signal phases match the extracted original finite schedule; unload/deactivate/native notifications are outside this probe.
Craftable mini portals do not transport entities. Dungeon portal-room code is a distinct vanilla-portal consumer.

preparation_attempts.detail: Initial scan-expression extraction also matched disable assignments; restricted to byte-cast scan expressions.

preparation_attempts.result: two failed probe compilations, second used only to expose diagnostics
preparation_attempts.detail: Original aligned getRedstoneIncoming spaces left tSide unresolved in generated oracle; replaced calls with whitespace-aware exact adaptation. No production compile defect.
Text metadata reader was initially used for a PNG; binary resource metadata now hashes bytes without UTF-8 decoding.
Corrected actual-core/source-fragment probe; scope and elapsed time above.
Forge getCollisionShape is public; locator initially expected protected. Actual public method subsequently inspected; no code behavior changed.

limits: Only readability and two comment corrections; no gameplay or registry identity changes.
No Gradle, whole-mod dual compilation, GameTest, game, rendering, save restart, build, push, issue comment or closure.
All optional dimensions, native transfer/lifecycle and remaining systems still require review; no global completion claim.
376 formal records include repaired/policy entries, not an unresolved count or percentage. Goal remains active.

root_revalidation.collision_override_inventory: No collision override in three concrete/common portal classes or three intermediate parents; Root default and block fallback both full.
root_revalidation.native_no_collision_consumers: Forge and Neo both set hasCollision false and return Shapes.empty when false; Forge collision method is public, Neo protected.
